SUB: Civil repairs of service bunkers of coke oven. INSTRUCTIONS TO THE BIDDERS I. BIDS NOT CONFORMING TO THE SPECIFICATION AND/OR TERMS & CONDITIONS OF THIS INVITATION TO TENDER ARE LIABLE FOR REJECTION. II. FIRMS TO CLEARLY INDICATE THEIR INCOME TAX PERMANENT ACCOUNT NUMBER (PAN) AND THE ISSUING AUTHORITY CITY. III. BIDDERS ARE REQUESTED TO READ THE TENDER DOCUMENT CAREFULLY AND SUBMIT THEIR OFFER AS PER TERMS AND CONDITIONS GIVEN THEREIN. BIDDERS WHO SUBMIT THEIR OFFERS SHALL BE DEEMED TO HAVE READ, UNDERSTOOD AND ACCEPTED THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE DOCUMENT . IV. TENDERER SHALL SUBMIT THE TECHNO-COMMERCIAL BID AND PRICE BID THROUGH ONLINE GEM PORTAL. V. GENERAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT (HEREIN AFTER REFERRED AS GCC) FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) SHALL BE APPLICABLE FOR THE SUBJECT CONTRACT. THE GENERAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) IS NOT ENCLOSED HEREWITH AND IS AVAILABLE IN THE STANDARD DOCUMENTS OF SAIL WEBSITE, WWW.SAILTENDERS.CO.IN FOR REFERENCE. VI. THE BIDDER NEED NOT SUBMIT COPY OF THE GENERAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT FOR PROCUREMEN T OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) ALONG WITH THE TENDER. HOWEVER, THE BIDDER BY SUBMITTING THE TENDER SHALL BE DEEMED TO HAVE READ AND UNDERSTOOD THE CONDITIONS OF THE GENERAL CONDITIONS OF CONTRACT FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) AND THE SAME SHALL, FOR ALL INTENTS AND PURPOSES, BE DEEMED TO BE FORMING INTEGRAL PART OF THE CONTRACT AND SHALL ALWAYS BE CONSTRUED ACCORDINGLY. VII. IN ADDITION TO GCC FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) THE INSTANT SPECIAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS AND STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS SHALL ALSO APPLY FOR THE SUBJECT TENDER/CONTRACT. VIII. WHEREVER SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS DIFFER FROM STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS / #GCC FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1)#, SPECIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS SHALL OVER-RIDE STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS / GCC. WHEREVER STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS DIFFER FROM GCC FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1), STANDARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS SHALL OVER-RIDE GCC. IX. WHEREVER GCC FOR PROCUREMENT OF SERVICES (SAIL # S1) DIFFERS FROM GEM GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (GTC), GEM GTC SHALL OVER-RIDE SAIL-S1. X.IN CASE ANY SPECIFIC ADVERSE REPORT IS RECEIVED AGAINST A TENDERER, AS AN INFORMATION OR UPON ENQUIRY MADE BY SAIL, IN RESPECT OF CAPABILITIES AND PERFORMANCE OF THE TENDERER, AFTER RECEIPT OF TENDER (EVEN AFTER OPENING OF PRICE BID), THE QUOTATION/

TENDER SUBMITTED BY SUCH TENDERER IS LIABLE TO BE REJECTED. XI. SHORTFALL DOCUMENTS/ CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS:- a) SAIL RESERVES ITS RIGHT TO, BUT WITHOUT ANY OBLIGATION TO DO SO, SEEK ANY SHORTFALL INFORMATION/ DOCUMENTS ONLY IN CASE OF HISTORICAL DOCUMENTS THAT PRE-EXISTED AT THE TIME OF THE BID OPENING, AND WHICH HAVE NOT UNDERGONE CHANGE SINCE THEN. b) NO POST-BID CLARIFICATION AT THE INITIATIVE OF THE BIDDER SHALL BE ENTERTAINED. c) DURING EVALUATION AND COMPARISON OF BIDS, SAIL-RSP MAY, AT HIS DISCRETION, ASK THE BIDDER FOR SUBMISSION OF SHORTFALL DOCUMENTS/ CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS/ CLARIFICATION ON BID. THE REQUEST FOR SEEKING SHORTFALL DOCUMENTS/ CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS/ CLARIFICATION AND THE RESPONSE SHALL BE IN WRITING. MODIFICATION OF THE BID AND ANY FORM OF COMMUNICATION WITH SAIL-RSP FOR SUBMISSION OF ANY ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS, NOT SPECIFICALLY ASKED FOR BY SAIL-RSP WILL NOT BE ALLOWED. AND EVEN IF SUBMITTED, THEY WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED. d) IF REQUIRED, WRITTEN COMMUNICATION/S SHALL BE DONE THROUGH GEM PORTAL, FOR SUBMISSION OF THE SHORT FALL DOCUMENTS/CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS/CLARIFICATION WITH A SPECIFIED DATE FOR SUBMISSION OF THE SAME. BIDDER SHALL BE REQUIRED TO SUBMIT SHORT FALL DOCUMENTS/CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS/CLARIFICATION TO THIS OFFICE BE DONE THROUGH GEM / E-PROCUREMENT PORTAL OR E-MAIL/ COURIER/ REGISTERED POST/SPEED POST WITH IN THE SPECIFIED TIME MENTIONED IN THE COMMUNICATION/S. THE ALLOWABLE TIME PERIOD FOR SUBMISSION OF THE SHORT FALL DOCUMENTS/CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS/CLARIFICATION WILL BE THE SOLE DISCRETION OF SAIL-RSP AND AS PER THE COMMUNICATION FROM SAIL-RSP BY THE BIDDER. IF THE TENDERER DOES NOT COMPLY OR RESPOND BY THE SPECIFIED DATE, HIS TENDER WILL BE EVALUATED BASED ON AVAILABLE DOCUMENTS. e) EVALUATION OF SIMILAR NATURE OF WORK OF RECEIVED OFFERS WILL BE DONE CONSIDERING THE RELEVANT SCOPE OF THE JOB EXECUTED BY THE TENDERER. MERELY THE MENTION OF THE "NAME OF WORK" OF THE WORK ORDER SUBMITTED WILL NOT BE INTERPRETED AS SIMILAR WORK. DECISION OF RSP SHALL BE FINAL AND BINDING ON THE TENDERER. #BIDDERS ARE THEREFORE ADVISED THAT THEY SHOULD TAKE DUE CARE WHILE UPLOADING OFFER / CONFIRMATORY DOCUMENTS IN ORDER TO AVOID REJECTION OF THEIR BID.# XII. MII & MSE PURCHASE PREFERENCE - PURCHASE PREFERENCE WILL BE GIVEN TO MAKE IN INDIA SUPPLIERS AND MSE SUPPLIERS,WHICH SHALL BE BASED ON THE EXTANT GUIDELINES OF GOVT. OF INDIA AND GUIDELINES OF SAIL PLANTS / UNITS. XIII. BID OF THE BIDDERS QUOTING BELOW 25% OF THE ESTIMATED VALUE SHALL BE TREATED AS ABNORMALLY LOW BID AND SUCH BIDDER/BIDDERS MAY BE ASKED TO SUBMIT PGB AS PER CLAUSE NO.38 OF STANDARD T&C. THIS IS NOT APPLICABLE FOR CASES WHERE MINIMUM FLOOR PRICE IS INDICATED IN THE TENDER.

DOCUMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED:- 1. COPY OF VALID "GST" REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE MENTIONING THE NEW GSTIN ALONG WITH SAC/HSN CODES FOR THE ITEMS YOU ARE APPLYING IN THE ABOVE TENDER IN THE "RFQ". 2. DOCUMENTS IN SUPPORT OF TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS. (AS PER ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA) 3. DOCUMENTS IN SUPPORT OF OWNERSHIP DETAILS (PROPRIETARY FIRM, PARTNERSHIP, PVT. LTD, PUBLIC LTD, ETC) 4. CERTIFICATE PERTAINING TO MSE, (IF REGISTERED AS MICRO OR SMALL ENTERPRISE UNDER MSMED ACT 2006). 5. VALID RSP VENDOR REGISTRATION CERTIFICATE (IF AVAILABLE) 6. UNDERTAKING AS PER ANNEXURE-A ON COMPANY LETTER HEAD 7. ACCEPTANCE OF ALL TERMS& CONDITIONS: ANNEXURE-1 8. CERTIFICATION FOR LOCAL CONTENT IN THE QUOTED ITEM (GOODS/WORKS/SERVICES), I.E. LOCAL CONTENT CERTIFICATE AS PER ANNEXURE -2A. NOTE: I) NON-SUBMISSION OF THE ABOVE DOCUMENTS MAY RENDER THE BID LIABLE FOR REJECTION. II) SAIL RESERVES THE RIGHT TO VERIFY ANY SUPPORTING DOCUMENT(S) SUBMITTED BY A PARTICIPATING TENDERER / BIDDER FROM ITS SOURCE (DOCUMENT ISSUING AUTHORITY). III) IN THE INTEREST OF EXPEDITIOUS COMPLETION OF VERIFICATION, A PARTICIPATING TENDERER /BIDDER SHALL PROVIDE A LIST OF EACH SUPPORTING DOCUMENT ON ITS LETTER-HEAD AS PER #ANNEXURE-S#, ALONG WITH THE CONTACT DETAILS (POSTAL ADDRESS, EMAIL ADDRESS, LANDLINE / MOBILE NUMBER) OF THE ISSUING AUTHORITY OF EACH SUPPORTING DOCUMENT FOR VERIFICATION. IV) NON-VERIFICATION OF ANY SUPPORTING DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION, AT THE SOLE DISCRETION OF SAIL, DOES NOT ABSOLVE THE TENDERER / BIDDER OF ITS ABSOLUTE RESPONSIBILITY TO PROVIDE ONLY GENUINE DOCUMENT(S) IN SUPPORT OF ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS. V) IN CASE A SUPPORTING DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION IS FOUND TO BE FAKE/FORGED/TAMPERED/ NON-GENUINE AT ANY STAGE DURING TENDERING PROCESS & EVEN AFTER PLACEMENT OF PURCHASE ORDER / WORK ORDER, THE TENDERER/BIDDER IS LIABLE FOR PUNITIVE ACTIONS AS PER EXTANT GUIDELINES OF SAIL. Eligibility Criteria :- "1. The Bidder must have experience of having successfully or substantially completed works similar to Civil work involving chemical repair & strengthening of Building /concrete structure or water proofing treatment work by chemical admixture/ Re-inforced Cement Concrete work against one time contract or under Rate Contracts/Empanelment Contracts jobs(Multiple orders combined together under one contract)in any Central / State Govt. Organisations / PSUs / Joint Venture Company where at least one of the partners shall be Central or State Government Organization or PSU /

Public Limited Company of the value as specified below during last Seven (07) years ending last day of month previous to the one in which tender is issued: (a) Three (03) completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 24.00 Lakhs each OR (b) Two (02) completed works each costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 30.00 Lakhs each OR (c) One (1) completed work costing not less than the amount equal to Rs. 48.00 Lakhs REQUISITE DOCUMENTS: # Self Attested copies of Work Orders # Self Attested copies of Completion certificate (issued by the concerned work executing Authority. # Substantially completed ongoing Work Orders having duration of contract of more than one year may also be considered for technical evaluation under ""similar work"" as per Eligibility Criteria, if the party has completed at least one year the period of work order and at least 50% of the work as per the work order. In such case already executed value shall be considered for evaluation. # In case work completion certificate is issued without value of completed work, RA bills paid or any other documents evidencing value of completed work may also be considered. # The Work order and completion certificate/paid bills so submitted should be in the name of participating tenderer. 2. The average annual financial turnover (exclusive of GST) of the bidder during the last Three (03) financial years ending 31st March 2026 shall be at least Rs. 18.00 Lakhs. The bidder shall submit Turnover Certificate from a practicing Chartered Accountant (CA). The Turnover Certificates issued by Chartered Accountant must contain valid UDIN (Unique Document Identification Number) and membership number of CA." NOTE: FOR SERVICE CONTRACTS WITH ESTIMATED VALUE UPTO RS. 5 CRORES, RELAXATION OF 15% IN FINANCIAL TURNOVER CRITERIA OF TENDERS IS APPLICABLE FOR MSES WHO ARE ELIGIBLE FOR PREFERENCE AND STARTUPS THAT ARE RECOGNIZED BY DEPARTMENT FOR INDUSTRY & INTERNAL TRADE (DPIIT). HOWEVER BOTH MSE AND STARTUPS SHALL HAVE TO MEET ELIGIBILITY CONDITIONS FOR QUALITY & TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENT. NECESSARY DOCUMENTS IN SUPPORT OF THE ELIGIBILITY STATUS AS ABOVE ARE TO BE SUBMITTED TO AVAIL THE RELAXATION. .
